QUOTE: `#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)  private_##member   /* default: member is renamed */` ... "so a user who writes `ctx->foo` gets a compile error"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the macro renames members (private_##member) so access by name fails at compile time. That is breaking the member name, not hiding the layout. It never says the layout is hidden.
